audit_notes: PQ 61-80 are now represented as structured records rather than only index entries.
Rewards are intentionally sparse where the independently checked sources did not establish exact attribution.
A listed reward is not automatically treated as an Ultimate Finish drop; drop attribution requires a separate reward-provenance pass.
The repository's final PQ numbering model remains under reconciliation because current sources document quests beyond older 100-PQ baselines.
